title: Fit needs diameter, not a colour
hook: Which lid matches the pictured round opening?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: that a lid fits only when its diameter matches the opening; colour and brand say nothing about size

misconception: A lid that looks like it belongs, with the same colour or brand, will fit.
objective: This fit test compares the opening diameter with lid diameter. A matching colour supplies no geometric constraint; the selected equal-diameter example meets the simplified size condition.
